To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a component simulation view of discrete-event simulation is possible, that it can be built from a set of simulation engines and communication ports, and that a hierarchical simulation methodology can be developed that is based on the classification of simulation components and communication ports.

(1) the simulation world is a component-based world, (2) simulation components must be linked in a type-specific way by simulation engines, (3) a component-based simulation model must include lookback, and (4) the simulation world can be modeled in a hierarchical way.
a component simulation view of discrete event simulation can be achieved by a hierarchical linking of simulation components via communication ports.
